get.summary: List reviews with optional status filter
get.description:
List reviews filtered by status.

- **PENDING** (default): reviews awaiting human decision
- **REVIEWED**: completed reviews (APPROVE / REJECT / MODIFY)
- **ALL**: no filter, returns everything

schema.title: Response Queue Api V1 Reviews Get

get.summary: Get a single review by ID

post.summary: Submit a final review decision (APPROVE / REJECT / MODIFY)
post.description:
Submit the human reviewer's decision on a pending AI-generated review.

- **APPROVE**: AI prediction is confirmed as correct
- **REJECT**: AI prediction is rejected (original is preserved for audit)
- **MODIFY**: reviewer provides corrections; originals are preserved alongside

DecisionResponse.title: DecisionResponse
DecisionResponse.description:
Concise response body for POST /reviews/{id}/decision.

Contains enough information for the frontend to update the UI
without a separate GET request.

ReviewQueueItem.title: ReviewQueueItem
ReviewQueueItem.description:
Returned by GET /reviews and GET /reviews/{id}.

Works for both PENDING and REVIEWED states.
reviewer_id is the human who made the final decision (None if still pending).
reviewed_at is the timestamp of the decision (None if still pending).

ReviewStatusFilter.title: ReviewStatusFilter
